title: The Shard Foundry

difficulty_contract.damage_rule: No damage may begin in a room transition, mandatory landing, stabilizer interaction, or pickup collection footprint.
difficulty_contract.recovery_rule: Each recovery heart sits after a challenge beat and never on an ordinary room spawn.

zone_plan.purpose: Teach baseline movement, descend through the Breathing Chamber, restore the first atmospheric stabilizer, ride the powered freight lift, cross the side-profile Atmosphere Lock, then award jet-assist.
zone_plan.challenge_peak: The Atmosphere Lock membrane remains red until restoration, turns green, retracts into its permanent housing on approach, and reforms after Aryn clears it; jet-assist waits beyond it.

zone_plan.purpose: Teach the heavy rifle, clear the mandatory Vesperite lock, then require one readable Deepworks recovery.
zone_plan.challenge_peak: A safe rifle acquisition, physical containment obstruction, recurring Sentinel, and one telegraphed thermal-purge crossing.
zone_plan.recovery: Deepworks is enemy-free and contains the zone's final Vesperite Fragment.

zone_plan.purpose: Test timing on the electrified catwalk, combine one air threat with one ground threat, and restore the second atmospheric stabilizer.
zone_plan.challenge_peak: Electrified-platform timing followed later by separated Ember Wasp, Chitin Sentinel, and Seam Hunter encounters.
zone_plan.recovery: Heart after the electric timing beat; optional Deepworks credit cache before the stabilizer.

zone_plan.purpose: Run a short armored final exam, recover the last Vesperite Fragment in a maintenance alcove, then deliberately travel to the Uplink Gate.
zone_plan.challenge_peak: Chitin Sentinel, then an embedded read-and-run or jet-assisted arc-coupler crossing and a separated Pale Watcher guard.
zone_plan.recovery: Heart on the upper route before the final plate, followed by a 324-pixel calm runway from the Pale Watcher patrol to the Wound lock.

zone_plan.purpose: Provide a quiet contrast layer with one required fragment recovery and one optional economic reward.
zone_plan.challenge_peak: Commit to a one-way drop, then use the guaranteed jet-assist to return.
zone_plan.recovery: No enemies and no contact hazards.

route.objective: Land on Veyra, meet Dras, and reach the Coreworks transport.
Recover equipment and learn the three traversal layers.
Restore two atmospheric stabilizers and reach the upper Uplink route.
systems: switchable telescopic laser seeker and heavy rifle for route clearing, bosses, and heavy combat

route.objective: Recover all twelve Vesperite Fragments, restore both stabilizers, and enter the Uplink Gate.

seam_portals.visual_rule: The steel housing never disappears; only the pressure membrane retracts and reforms.
seam_portals.crossing_rule: Close only after Aryn's complete collision body clears the opposite housing, and reverse safely if she returns.

visual_affordance_cleanup.rule: The baked center junction is hidden in every normal and mirrored plate; only collision-backed runtime platforms may visually span the gap.

authored_hazards.solution: read the warning shutters, wait for the purge to end, then jump
read the recessed warning rails and cross during discharge, take the insulated upper transfer, or use earned jet-assist

population.surface_return: Wound-touched Vesperite recovery fades to black and returns Aryn to Veyra with the recovered loadout; the completed Coreworks return route is sealed

encounter_order: Foundry Intake: Chitin Sentinel on the broad ground lane; Squircle Minion visibly circles an upper platform
Breathing Chamber: Core Leech in the air lane, then Chitin Sentinel before the stabilizer apron
Refinery Entry: a second Core Leech on the upper return, safe heavy-rifle pickup, Kihunter read, physical obstruction, then Chitin Sentinel
Refinery Exit: rifle-valid Sova and Chitin Sentinel in separated lanes, telegraphed thermal purge, then enemy-free Deepworks recovery
Biolab Entry: guaranteed Ember Wasp above a ground Chitin Sentinel with no shared mandatory landing
Biolab Stabilizer: a third Core Leech remains on the upper lane while Seam Hunter and Chitin Sentinel are separated before a safe stabilizer apron
Deepworks Approach: Skree and Chitin Sentinel are separated before the upper-route recovery heart
Uplink Gate: final fragment in the left maintenance alcove, Seam Lurker above, broken arc coupler on deck, Pale Watcher beyond it, then a separate gate approach
